task_results.title: Audit effective runtime dependencies
task_results.message: Kod ve Cloud Run config uzerinden runtime'in Cloud SQL ve iki Secret Manager secret'i kullandigi, GCS upload'in ise ancak Gcs:BucketName ayarlanirsa devreye girecegi dogrulandi.

task_results.title: Move secret access to resource scope
task_results.message: BEACHGO_DB_CONN ve JWT_SECRET_KEY secret'lerine serviceAccount:beach-api-sa icin resource-level secretAccessor binding eklendi.

task_results.title: Remove broad project-level runtime roles
task_results.message: Project-level roles owner, storage.admin, secretmanager.secretAccessor, artifactregistry.writer ve cloudbuild.serviceAgent runtime service account'tan kaldirildi; yalnizca cloudsql.client birakildi.

task_results.title: Cold-start validation after IAM hardening
task_results.message: IAM degisikligi sonrasi no-op revision dogrulamasi icin 00019 olusturuldu, ardindan marker temizlenerek aktif revision 00020-4ls ile final cold-start saglikli dogrulandi.

task_results.title: Second-pass review
task_results.message: Gemini kalan not olarak ileride production GCS bucket aktif edilirse bucket-level storage izni verilmesi ve ek secret'lar Secret Manager'a tasininca yeni accessor binding'lerin eklenmesi gerektigini belirtti.

verification_results.name: project-iam-after-hardening
verification_results.message: Runtime service account icin project-level yalnizca roles/cloudsql.client kaldi.

verification_results.name: secret-iam-beachgo-db-conn
verification_results.message: BEACHGO_DB_CONN secret'i uzerinde runtime service account icin secretAccessor goruldu.

verification_results.name: secret-iam-jwt-secret-key
verification_results.message: JWT_SECRET_KEY secret'i uzerinde runtime service account icin secretAccessor goruldu.

verification_results.name: cloud-run-cold-start-health
verification_results.message: IAM hardening sonrasi aktif revision beachrehberi-api-00020-4ls ile swagger endpoint 200 dondu.

verification_results.name: cloud-run-revision-00020-startup
verification_results.message: Yeni revision healthy oldu; startup probe basarili ve DbInitializer log'lari goruldu.
